spec2def(olepro32.dll olepro32.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(olepro32 regtypelib olepro.idl)

# olepro32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/olepro32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(olepro32_shims OBJECT olepro32stubs.c)
target_link_libraries(olepro32_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload liboleaut32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(olepro32_shims)
add_dependencies(olepro32_shims stdole2)
set(OLEPRO32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/olepro32/olepro_t.o)
add_cargo_module(olepro32 olepro32-cargo olepro32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS olepro32_shims psdk olepro32_t ${OLEPRO32_REUSED})
